title: IBPS Clerk 2026
summary: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for IBPS Clerk 2026 for recruitment to Clerical Cadre posts in participating public sector banks. Graduates from any recognized university aged between 20 and 28 years are eligible to apply online. Selected candidates will be placed in public sector banks across India.
highlights: Recruitment for Clerical Cadre posts across participating Public Sector Banks
Educational Qualification: Degree (Graduation) in any discipline
Age Limit: 20 to 28 years with applicable age relaxation
Selection based strictly on Preliminary and Main online examinations (No Interview)
eligibility: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized University or any equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. Operating and working knowledge in computer systems is necessary (a certificate/diploma/degree in computer operations/language or computer/IT studied as a subject in High School/College is required). Proficiency in the official language of the State/UT for which vacancies are applied is desirable. The age limit is 20 to 28 years with relaxation for reserved categories (5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10 years for PwBD).
howToApply:
1. Go to the official website www.ibps.in.
2. Click on the CRP Clerical link and select 'Apply Online for CRP Clerks-XVI'.
3. Complete the 'NEW REGISTRATION' by filling in basic contact details.
4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per guidelines.
5. Fill in personal, educational details, and bank preferences.
6. Pay the application fee through online payment gateways and submit the application form.

faqs.question: What is the minimum educational qualification for IBPS Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

faqs.question: Is there an interview stage for IBPS Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: No, there is no interview for IBPS Clerk. Selection is made based purely on marks scored in the Main Examination.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for IBPS Clerk candidates?
faqs.answer: The age limit is 20 to 28 years. Relaxation in upper age limit is provided to SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates per government guidelines.
